tenderSchedule.description: SELECTION OF AGENCY FOR PROVIDING SECURITY GUARDS AND HOSUE KEEPING PERSONNEL

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A bidder should have executed one Security Guard deployment contract involving the deployment of 20 resources for period of one year in the similar area. (copies of relevant work orders)
Previous and present details of deployment of Security Guard to the Govt. offices
Registered under Labour License Act. (Certificate of Labour License incorporation and commencement of services)
Bidder should hold valued GST registration certificate (copy of GST registration certificate)
Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by income tax department. (copy of Permanent Account number)
The Bidder should have an annual turnover at least 20 lakhs in the business of providing of Guards deployment services each year in last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registered copy of ESI and PF.
License of clearance certificate from Police Department
